description: Per-model USD rates per 1M tokens, used by scripts/vajra-cost.sh. Cache write is the input rate x cacheWriteMult (5-minute cache); cache read is the input rate x cacheReadMult. A model with no matching entry is reported by tokens only (cost '?'); a rate is never invented.
notes: match is a substring tested against the model id, e.g. 'claude-opus-5-5' matches 'opus-5-5'.
The array is ordered from most specific to least; the first match wins.
Legacy entries price transcripts from older models. Correct them here if your older model's rate differs.
Token totals and cache-hit rate are exact whether or not a rate is known.
